description: This PHP class 'ApiAuthorizationSubscriber' subscribes to kernel events to handle API authorization and exception responses within the OrangeHRM system. It manages access control for API endpoints based on user roles and permissions, throwing Forbidden exceptions when unauthorized access is detected, and formats error responses for forbidden access.

classes.name: ApiAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: Handles API authorization and exception responses by subscribing to kernel controller and exception events, enforcing permission checks based on user roles, and returning appropriate error responses.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically controller and exception events.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Checks if the current controller is authorized to access the API based on permissions; throws ForbiddenException if not authorized.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles ForbiddenException by returning a formatted 403 Forbidden response.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller instance from the event.

methods.name: getPermissionGetterMethod
methods.description: Maps HTTP methods to permission getter method names (e.g., 'canRead' for GET).
